formulas.ascii: Objective, not the procedure: inertia J = sum over valid points i of |(x_i - o) - shiftedCenter_l(i)|^2, with l(i) the nearest center (lowest center id wins ties) in f32. With centerCoordinates: true (explicit in this scenario), o is the origin of each point's cluster (the point that cluster was seeded from or relocated to), each Lloyd update sums x_i - o in fixed order and divides by n_k, and assignments and squared distances retain the shifted centers. Published centers add o back and round to f32; recomputing distances from those rounded absolute centers can differ. An explicit false uses o = 0 and requests historical raw-coordinate arithmetic. A center that gets no point is relocated to the points farthest from their centers. Initial centers are k-means++ (seeded) or the first k valid points; with restarts the lowest J wins.
